# Vendored kit contract

`modules.json` and `kit-manifest.schema.json` are copied unchanged from [homemade-claude-kit](https://github.com/VictorHueni/homemade-claude-kit) at commit `cdb01eb`, path `plugins/delivery-comms/contract/`, delivery-comms design contract 2.0.0. The contract belongs to the kit (Plan-0002, Principle 4): this repository tests against these files and never edits them. A newer contract is adopted deliberately, by copying both files again from a named kit commit and updating this line.
